description: Turn the weekly account health check on or off and choose whether it drafts fixes. Pass only the fields to change. Checks never send email to subscribers or activate anything: autonomy draft_fixes only creates inactive draft sequences. Checks run every Monday at 05:00 UTC, before the Monday weekly report that carries the findings; the schedule is fixed. Who gets the findings is each person's own account_health notification preference (update_notification_preferences), not a workspace setting. Owner or admin only. Requires companies:manage.

autonomy.description: draft_fixes lets the agent lay out up to 2 inactive draft sequences per check for gaps it finds (named for the business, with trigger, timing and titled email steps; the check writes no email, they are written when the draft is opened in the dashboard or create_account_health_fix is called for its insight); report_only only reports.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

enabled.description: Turn scheduled checks on or off.
